articles.title: Group has 'exploded' after Wales win - Bellamy
articles.summary: Craig Bellamy says Wales' win over Norway has "thrown a hand grenade" into their Nations League group as they go in search of another victory against Denmark in Cardiff on Sunday.

articles.title: What does Man City guilty verdict mean for their squad?
articles.summary: BBC Sport looks at how Manchester City's guilty verdict will affect their existing players' futures and the club's dealings in the transfer market.
